## Inpatient

## CEFIPIME AND VANCOMYCIN
## FOR PERITONITIS ASSOCIATED WITH PERITONEAL DIALYSIS
Cefepime 1 gm PD q24h and vancomycin 30 mg/kg PD loading dose followed by 15
mg/kg PD every 3 to 7 days in 2000 mL 2.5% dextrose diaslyate solution.
[to order WITH heparin](orz-set-abx-pd-cefepime-and-vanco-hep-low-mag-2-5)
If Heparin is contraindicated then:
[to order WITHOUT heparin](orz-set-abx-pd-cefepime-and-vanco-low-mag-2-5)

# # Outpatient

## VANCOMYCIN
## FOR PERITONITIS ASSOCIATED WITH PERITONEAL DIALYSIS
## Choose loading dose based on patient's adjusted body weight (AJBW)
## (see below for AJBW calculation)
## AJBW < 50 kg:
[Vancomycin 1000 mg PD loading dose, pharmacy to redose in in 3-7 days](orz-set-abx-op-pd-vanco-1000mg-ld-redose-q3-7d-cefepime-qd)
## AJBW >/= 50 kg and <85 kg:
[Vancomycin 2000 mg PD loading dose, pharmacy to redose in in 3-7 days](orz-set-abx-op-pd-vanco-2000mg-ld-redose-q3-7d-cefepime-qd)
## AJBW >/= 85 kg:
[Vancomycin 3000 mg PD loading dose, pharmacy to redose in in 3-7 days](orz-set-abx-op-pd-vanco-3000mg-ld-redose-q3-7d-cefepime-qd)
## Pharmacy may be contacted at pager number 612-818-0841 for dosing information.
Calculations:
AJBW = Ideal Body Weight (IBW) + 0.4 (Actual Body Weight - IBW)
IBW:
Males: IBW = 50 kg + 2.3 kg for each inch over 5 feet
Females: IBW = 45.5 kg + 2.3 kg for each inch over 5 feet
Inpt: ORZID2 GMENU PD CEFEPIME 1GM Q24H VANCO 15-30MG/KG Q5-7D
Outpt: ORZID3 GMENU PD VANCO 30MG/KG LD CEFEPIME 1GM Q24H
